parameters.query:
=SELECT Id, Name, Company, Country, Email 
    FROM Lead 
    WHERE Country LIKE '%{{ $fromAI("country","", "string") }}%' 
    AND Company LIKE '%{{ $fromAI("company","", "string") }}%'

=SELECT 
    a.Id,
    a.Name,
    a.BillingCountry,
    a.Phone,
    a.Website,
    a.Type,
    a.Rating,
    a.Site,
    a.Account_Segment__c,
    a.Fabric_Process__c,
    a.CreatedDate,
    a.LastModifiedDate,
    (SELECT 
        c.Id,
        c.FirstName,
        c.LastName,
        c.Email,
        c.Phone,
        c.Title,
        c.Department
     FROM Contacts c),
    (SELECT 
        o.Id,
        o.Name,
        o.Amount,
        o.StageName,
        o.CloseDate,
        o.Type,
        o.Probability
     FROM Opportunities o
     WHERE o.IsClosed = false)
FROM Account a
WHERE a.Name LIKE '%{{$fromAI("name","","string")}}%'
AND a.BillingCountry LIKE '%{{$fromAI("country","","string")}}%'
ORDER BY a.Name ASC
LIMIT 10
